document.h: Curriculum Vitae – Franck Delahaye (Targeted for Alan – Fullstack Software Engineer – Global Architecture)

section.p:
Franck Delahaye
franck_delahaye@yahoo.fr
+33 7 67 38 28 95
Grenoble, France (eligible to work in France; open to hybrid/remote within France/Belgium/Spain)
Senior software engineer & solutions architect – global-ready modules, data model harmonization, APIs/integrations, structured data (XML/JSON), high-traffic platforms.

Senior software engineer / solutions architect (25+ years) building and operating business-critical platforms across high-traffic web, integration services, and data-centric systems. Strong in designing cross-cutting components, harmonizing heterogeneous data models into unified schemas (without losing local flexibility), and delivering contract-first APIs with robust validation and observability. Experienced in multi-country product contexts, legacy-to-modular refactoring, and close collaboration with product and operations teams. Comfortable shipping and maintaining what I design; pragmatic trade-offs, written-first communication, mentoring and cross-team enablement.

li.p: Designing global, reusable modules replacing country-specific implementations; identifying blockers spanning domains and removing them with durable building blocks.
Data model harmonization: consolidation of heterogeneous schemas into unified, configurable models; structured content governance and validation (XML/XSD, JSON Schema).
Trade-off driven engineering: incremental migration patterns, compatibility layers, and long-term maintainability in fast-moving product environments.
REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, webhook-based integrations, contract-first design, explicit error handling.
Enterprise / SaaS integrations: CRM/ERP/marketplaces/search/marketing tools; multi-system synchronization and workflow automation.
Service refactoring: extracting services/jobs, progressive modularization of legacy codebases, and production-grade operational practices.
Structured data engineering: XML, XSLT, XQuery; JSON, JSONPath; schema validation and transformations for downstream systems.
Datastores: PostgreSQL, MySQL; XML databases: BaseX, eXist-db; indexing feeds and data synchronization patterns.
CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD), Docker, Linux; reproducible environments and multi-environment deployments.
Observability: dashboards/KPIs, log analysis (including Kibana); incident-driven improvements (latency, error rate, reliability).
Collaboration: backlog-driven delivery, written documentation, code reviews, mentoring, cross-team coordination.
PHP/Symfony (high-traffic platforms, back-offices, integrations), Java/J2EE (Spring, three-tier architectures), Ballerina (integration/orchestration services).
Python (connexe to the role requirements): Odoo ERP integrations/customizations and data-centric workflows.

Modern JavaScript (connexe to the role requirements): front/back collaboration, API-driven applications, and structured CMS UI customization (HTML/CSS/JS); Angular experience on API-consuming front-ends.

p.strong: Cosmobilis – Chambéry, France – Senior Lead Developer & Architect (high-traffic platforms, integrations, modularization)

li.p: Dates: Jan 2023 – Present
Designed and maintained integration-heavy backend services and APIs across multi-site / multi-country web platforms; ensured stable contracts between front/back systems and third-party services.
Removed cross-domain technical blockers by extracting reusable services/connectors (integration modules, ETL jobs, shared components) and standardizing contracts/validation across flows.

Orchestrated data transformations and synchronization workflows between heterogeneous systems (Salesforce CRM and OpenFlex ERP), including mapping, status lifecycles, multi-country scenarios, and traceability.
Production ownership: CI/CD workflows, Docker/AWS environments, monitoring (KPIs/log analysis), and incident-driven improvements for reliability and performance.

Enterprise Application Integration Service (Salesforce <-> OpenFlex ERP) (Jan 2024 – Present): API-based synchronization of leads/opportunities workflows; message-oriented orchestration patterns; end-to-end automated scenario testing to reduce regressions.
Componentized Ballerina services (monorepo): shared connector modules (databases/external APIs), modular ETL jobs, and reproducible delivery pipelines for multi-environment deployments.

High-traffic legacy migration (elite-auto.fr) (Sep 2024 – Sep 2025): infrastructure migration to AWS VM and progressive refactoring toward service-oriented components while maintaining production stability.

p.strong: tchatapi.org – Internal product demo / R&D – Product & Technical Author (API workflow orchestration)

li.p: Dates: Oct 2024 – Present
Designed and implemented a multi-step API orchestration engine to execute complex scenarios defined as schema-driven JSON (typed request hierarchy, validation, reproducibility).
Implemented response memory and JSONPath-based reuse of previous outputs to enrich subsequent steps (context injection patterns for downstream processing).
Exposed orchestration via CLI and OpenAPI/Swagger UI for inspection, debugging, and non-code execution.
Reference: tchatapi.org; source/documentation: GitHub repository.

Designed integration architectures and data synchronization flows (Talend-based ETL); implemented patterns to consolidate data across systems while preserving domain-specific constraints.
Operated production platforms: CI/CD (GitLab), Dockerized environments, monitoring/dashboards (including Kibana), incident resolution with business stakeholders.
Technical leadership: mentoring, code reviews, architecture documentation, cross-team coordination (marketing, logistics, finance, support).

Energy billing platform: Odoo-based invoicing/accounting driven by structured messages; Python customizations and integration work.
